## Overview

This [[adyen]] page, modified and captured 2026-09-15, is a brief **Apple Pay Web integration chooser**. It links to Web Drop-in and Web Components Apple Pay guides, plus their main Web integration documentation. See [[adyen-online-payments]]. It does not itself give certificate, browser, SDK, account, request, result or payment-lifecycle requirements. See raw lines 15–29.

## Key takeaways

- The **Drop-in** child is described as an all-in-one UI solution for adding Apple Pay to a website. The **Components** child is described as a pre-built Component to render Apple Pay on a website. These are navigation descriptions; they do not establish that either option is configured or available for a particular merchant or shopper. See raw lines 19–27.
- The page also links the main Web Drop-in and Components integration guides. It does not choose a Sessions/Advanced flow, certificate model, Component version or browser condition. Read the chosen child and main guide for those details. See raw line 29.
- No payment request or response appears here. The chooser does not evidence Apple Pay authentication, Adyen authorization, capture or settlement. See raw lines 15–29.
